newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian truck sales fell 5.97 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Italian truck sales fell 5.97 pct in February.

text.p: Italian commercial vehicle sales dipped 5.97 percent in February year-on-year to 11,774, Italian auto manufacturing association Anfia said.
In the first two months of this year, sales were down 8.45 percent to 22,636, Anfia said in a statement.
Italian truck makers saw sales fall 9.52 percent in February to 6,482 giving them a market share of 55.05 percent against 57.21 percent in February last year.

But among foreign marques, Mercedes saw truck sales jump 120 percent to 903 units giving it an Italian market share of 7.67 percent, and Volkswagen sales rose 162 percent to 498 giving a market share of 4.23 percent.
